title: MV/MZ Is AdMob Still Needed in the Android RPG Maker Industry?

posts.author: Anaryx_plugin
posts.body:
Hello developers
I'd like to open a discussion and introduce a tool I'm developing.
Currently, many RPG Maker MZ and RPG Maker MV developers want to release their games for Android.
However, the process is usually quite complicated because you have to:
Install Android Studio
Set up Gradle
Configure the SDK
Generate APK / AAB Manually
Integrate Google AdMob Manually
For non-programmers, this can be quite confusing.
Solution: AG APK Builder
I'm working on AG APK Builder, which is developing a tool that allows you to:
Build APK & AAB directly
Without Android Studio
No coding
Just click and build
Automatic AdMob plugin integration
With this tool, developers can focus on building their games in RPG Maker, while the builder handles the Android process.
Plugin AdMob untuk RPG Maker
This plugin can be used directly without coding and supports:
Banner Ads
Interstitial Ads
Rewarded Ads
App Open
Ads All can be invoked via event commands (plugin commands), so there's no need to edit the Android source code at all.
The goal is simple:
Developers focus on making games
Monetization can run immediately
No technical hassle on Android
Question for the Community
Before I release the final version of the AdMob plugin, I'd like to ask:
Is AdMob still needed for RPG Maker Android games?
Are you still using the ad monetization model?
Is a no-code tool like AG APK Builder helpful?
I'd love to hear your thoughts before the official release  If anyone is interested in trying the early version, I'll share the download link here as well. Thank You

Thank you for your opinion
Yes, I agree. Ads should not ruin the gameplay experience.
That’s why in my plugin I focus more on:
Optional rewarded ads (for bonus rewards)
Flexible banner/interstitial control
Developer decides how and when ads appear
For example:
Watch ad → get 2x gold
Watch ad → revive
Watch ad → unlock bonus
So it’s not forced, but optional monetization.
My goal is not to push ads into every game, but to give RPG Maker developers an easier monetization option without needing Android Studio.
I really appreciate your feedback!
